planets.name: KELT-11 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KELT-11 with a 4.74-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: KELT-11 b was found in 2017 by KELT-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KELT-11. Its orbit and size follow Mounzer et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
